properties.name: pqs:context
properties.value: epee's HTTP digest auth offers MD5 alongside SHA-256 (md5_ : digest_base_<EVP_md5,16>, RFC 7616 'historic', with a disable_md5 option to refuse it); the unit tests exercise the production implementation. Weak hash — collision-prone; kept only for legacy interop.

properties.name: pqs:context
properties.value: Wallet-seed KDF for the polyseed format: PBKDF2-HMAC-SHA256 over the wallet password. The iteration count is supplied by the external polyseed C library at the pd.pbkdf2_sha256 callback (polyseed.cpp:88) and is not pinned anywhere in this tree — upstream polyseed specifies 10,000 iterations, well below OWASP's 600,000 recommendation for PBKDF2-HMAC-SHA256. The primitive itself is standard; the 'weak' rating reflects the fast (non-memory-hard) KDF choice, a deliberate polyseed tradeoff on a 16-by

properties.name: pqs:context
properties.value: Posture control: verification is disabled only when explicitly configured (ssl_verification_t::none — e.g. --untrusted-daemon users with SSL off), or on the server side when no client-cert fingerprints/CA are configured (client certs not requested). All other paths use verify_peer|verify_fail_if_no_peer_cert with fingerprint pinning or CA + hostname verification.

properties.name: pqs:context
properties.value: Posture observations, not exploitable channels on the sites seen: all 122 sites compare public values (tx/block hashes, seed hashes, protocol magics, type signatures) where no secret depends on the comparison time; several matches are name collisions (e.g. signature_size). Monero's secret-dependent comparisons (scalars, key images, MACs) route through constant-time primitives — sodium crypto_verify_32 (rctTypes.h) and sc_check — not through these sites.

properties.name: pqs:context
properties.value: Dev/test tooling only; no key material or security-sensitive randomness anywhere in this object.

properties.name: pqs:context
properties.value: Trezor session-key protection: AEAD secretbox from libsodium; Poly1305 tag verified on decrypt, exception raised on failure. PQ-safe symmetric AEAD.

properties.name: pqs:context
properties.value: Same polyseed PBKDF2 sites: iteration count arrives from the external polyseed C library (upstream value 10,000, below the OWASP 600k PBKDF2-SHA256 minimum); posture observation until the polyseed C source revision is pinned. PQ-safe primitive (symmetric KDF).

properties.name: pqs:context
properties.value: FCMP++ Rust dependency inventory: k256/secp256k1 is a transitive curve backend of the generic ciphersuite crate; the lockfile pins it while only the ed25519 feature is enabled (Helioselene/Selene path), so it is compiled-in availability rather than an exercised code path. Shor-vulnerable if used.

properties.name: pqs:context
properties.value: Data-at-rest protection for a TLS identity key; CFB is unauthenticated and OpenSSL legacy PKCS8 PEM encryption uses a weak KDF — worth noting in posture, though symmetric (PQ-safe).

properties.name: pqs:context
properties.value: RingCT amount-masking ECDH over Curve25519/ed25519 is the core transaction-confidentiality mechanism; the net_ssl.cpp site is the production TLS 1.2 ECDHE configuration for P2P/RPC. Both Shor-vulnerable (harvest-now-decrypt-later for the TLS traffic; long-term confidentiality of amounts).

properties.name: pqs:context
properties.value: The ref10 ed25519 implementation underlying all Monero key/signature operations (one-time addresses, key images, ring signatures) — Shor-vulnerable; replaceable only via a network-wide hard fork (Monero PQ roadmap), not by an application patch. fcmp_pp Rust selects the same curve via the ciphersuite/ec-divisors ed25519 features.

properties.name: pqs:context
properties.value: Monero's transaction-privacy ECDH: X25519 scalar mult of the tx public key by the view secret key derives output one-time addresses and amount masks. Shor breaks all historical amounts' confidentiality; replaceable only by consensus migration (Monero PQ roadmap).

properties.name: pqs:context
properties.value: Production TLS config for Monero P2P/RPC: ECDHE-ECDSA suites negotiate ECDSA client/server certs; Shor-relevant key exchange.

properties.name: pqs:context
properties.value: FCMP++ Rust dependency inventory: curve25519-dalek is the curve/field backend for Helioselene/Selene (Curve25519 twists) used by the FCMP++ tree proofs and dalek-ff-group. Shor-vulnerable — the FCMP curve set is exactly what a future PQ Monero would have to migrate.

properties.name: pqs:context
properties.value: FCMP++ Rust dependency inventory: p256 backend of the generic ciphersuite crate; only ed25519 features are enabled, so P-256/ECDSA is compiled-in availability, not an exercised path. Shor-vulnerable if used.

properties.name: pqs:context
properties.value: Test fixture pinning the TLS 1.2 and 1.3 floors the epee client is exercised against; production floor is TLS 1.2 (net_ssl.cpp:209-212).

properties.name: pqs:context
properties.value: Monero's core hash: Keccak-f[1600] sponge in the CryptoNote Keccak-256 variant (pre-SHA3 padding) used for tx/block IDs, tree/root hashes, key derivation (H2s/H2p via keccak+sc_reduce), HMAC-Keccak for the Trezor session MAC, and the PRNG sponge in random.c. PQ-safe (Grover-halved). Uniform across all 200 sites/13 files.

properties.name: pqs:context
properties.value: Vendored BLAKE2b implementation (crypto_blake2b_* API, RFC 7693-style) compiled into the Monero crypto library; the only in-tree consumer is the hash test harness (tests/hash 'blake2b' target) — no application call site found in src/, so this is available-in-shipped-library rather than exercised crypto. PQ-safe hash.

properties.name: pqs:context
properties.value: SHA-256 is the strong digest for epee TLS (X509_sign at net_ssl.cpp:179, X509_digest fingerprint pinning at :371, get_hr_ssl_fingerprint), tools::sha256, and the polyseed HMAC-SHA256 inner PRF; the http.cpp sites verify the SHA-256 digest-auth variant. PQ-safe (Grover-halved to 128 bits).

properties.name: pqs:context
properties.value: PQ-safe MAC inside the polyseed wallet-seed encryption KDF; sodium-compatible HMAC-SHA256 vendored from upstream pbkdf2.

properties.name: pqs:context
properties.value: Polyseed (modern Monero wallet seed) derives its encryption key from the wallet password with PBKDF2-HMAC-SHA256; PQ-safe KDF (symmetric). Iteration count is supplied by the polyseed C library at the pd.pbkdf2_sha256 call.

properties.name: pqs:context
properties.value: AES-128 appears in the production TLS 1.2 suite list (GCM, authenticated) and as the legacy PKCS8 PEM cipher for the generated TLS private key at rest (unauthenticated CFB + weak legacy PEM KDF).

properties.name: pqs:context
properties.value: AES-256 is the core of the CryptoNight memory-hard slow hash (PoW and wallet password KDF) via AES-NI key expansion, and appears as ECDHE-AES256-GCM TLS suites. PQ-safe symmetric.
